milestones.note: Wikipedia dates the idea to about 1970; the 1974 survey is the verified record, so the year is the publication year.

milestones.note: 'First systematic treatment' is a judgement from the role of the book in the literature, not checked against earlier monographs; it sets the institutional date by rule.

milestones.work: Berkovich, Spectral theory and analytic geometry over non-Archimedean fields, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 33, AMS (1990)
